picnicker.name: Picnicker
dialog: I spent all morning at the top of the observatory, looking out over the Great Marsh.
Different Pokémon come out to play in the mud every day. I could watch them for hours!

black_belt.name: Black Belt
dialog: Our Gym Leader is a wrestler, and he never holds anything back!
His Pokémon are all Water types. Bring something that doesn't mind a soaking.

ace_trainer_m_1.name: Trainer
dialog: This Clefairy follows me everywhere. I hardly ever put it in its ball.
It likes Pastoria's sunshine as much as I do.

collector_1.name: Collector
dialog: The Great Marsh is different from one day to the next.
A Pokémon you saw yesterday might not show its face today. That's what keeps me coming back.

scientist_m.name: Scientist
dialog: Marsh mud is full of minerals. It keeps the skin of Water Pokémon healthy.
No wonder so many of them make their homes out there.

beauty.name: Beauty
dialog: I came all this way to see the Great Marsh.
Now I'm here, I'm not sure I dare walk in the mud in these shoes.

parasol_lady.name: Parasol Lady
dialog: Just west of town, on Route 212, the rain hardly ever stops.
In Pastoria the sun shines, but I keep my parasol up anyway. You never know!

collector_2.name: Collector
dialog: Some of the Pokémon in the Great Marsh live nowhere else in Sinnoh.
Collectors like me come from all over, just for a chance to catch one.

ace_trainer_m_2.name: Trainer
dialog: The Gym here hits you with wave after wave of Water moves.
So I'm buying every Potion the Poké Mart has on its shelves.

signs.map_signpost:
Pastoria City
Where the wetlands begin and the wild comes right up to the door.
signs.gym_signpost:
Pastoria City Pokémon Gym
Leader: Crasher Wake
His Water Pokémon hit like a breaking wave!
signs.signboard_great_marsh:
Great Marsh Observatory

signs.signboard_safari_game:
Safari Game
